react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven differentially abundant metabolites form a tightly coordinated eicosanoid network rooted in arachidonic acid (AA) metabolism. Across three independent analytical paradigms — RaMP multi-database ORA (FDR 9.2×10⁻¹⁸), Mummichog m/z-network enrichment (p=4.2×10⁻⁴), and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p=7.5×10⁻⁸) — KEGG:hsa00590 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' and its Mummichog analogue 'MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism' are the unambiguous top-ranked pathways. Five of the seven metabolites are direct products or intermediates of AA metabolism: arachidonic acid itself (KEGG:C00219) is the central substrate; leukotriene A4 (C00909) and 5(S)-HETE (C04805) branch through the 5-lipoxygenase axis; 15(S)-HETE (C04742) and its downstream trihydroxy product 11,12,15-THETA (C14782) reflect 15-lipoxygenase activity; and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (C14717) is a downstream cyclopentenone prostaglandin produced via the cyclooxygenase pathway. CDP (C00112) did not map to any AA pathway in any paradigm and likely reflects a separate nucleotide-related perturbation. The coordinated elevation of these eicosanoids indicates the treatment drives systemic activation of phospholipase A2-mediated AA release followed by parallel stimulation of the 5-LOX, 12/15-LOX, and COX axes, with the cyclopentenone prostaglandin 15d-PGJ2 suggesting additional PPARγ-mediated anti-inflammatory signaling cross-talk.

react_result.final_narrative_text: Three independent pathway-analysis methods converged on Arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant biological signal. Mummichog m/z-network enrichment (p = 9.24 × 10⁻⁴) identified MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism as its top-ranked pathway, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 7.54 × 10⁻⁸) ranked KEGG:hsa00590 first, and RaMP multi-database ORA (FDR = 9.17 × 10⁻¹⁸) returned the same six eicosanoid input metabolites across all its top SMPDB hits. Five metabolites—arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219), 5-HETE (KEGG:C04805), 15-HETE (KEGG:C04742), leukotriene A4 (KEGG:C00909), and 11,12,15-THETA (KEGG:C14782)—are verified members of the Mummichog Arachidonic acid metabolism pathway and drove the enrichment signal. 15-Deoxy-d-12,14-PGJ2 (KEGG:C14717) additionally hit the SMPDB Rofecoxib Action Pathway in RaMP but was not a driver of the Mummichog or MetaboAnalystR Arachidonic acid metabolism hits. CDP (KEGG:C00112) mapped only to Mummichog N-Glycan biosynthesis and Vitamin B5-CoA biosynthesis, indicating a separate nucleotide-related perturbation. Arachidonic acid is the common substrate for both the 5-lipoxygenase reaction producing LTA4 and the COX/PG synthase axis.

Across three independent analytical paradigms — RaMP multi-database ORA (FDR 9.2×10⁻¹⁸), Mummichog m/z-network enrichment (p=4.2×10⁻⁴), and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p=7.5×10⁻⁸) — KEGG:hsa00590 'Arachidonic acid metabolism' and its Mummichog analogue 'MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism' are the unambiguous top-ranked pathways. Five of the seven metabolites are direct products or intermediates of AA metabolism: arachidonic acid itself (KEGG:C00219) is the central substrate; leukotriene A4 (C00909) and 5(S)-HETE (C04805) branch through the 5-lipoxygenase axis; 15(S)-HETE (C04742) and its downstream trihydroxy product 11,12,15-THETA (C14782) reflect 15-lipoxygenase activity; and 15-deoxy-Δ¹²,¹⁴-prostaglandin J2 (C14717) is a downstream cyclopentenone prostaglandin produced via the cyclooxygenase pathway.
